outcomeNote: A bare mishna lemma; the biur ends 'ושואלים:' and the question (מנא הני מילי) is asked in the following unit.

segments.he: חֲסִידִים הָרִאשׁוֹנִים הָיוּ שׁוֹהִין שָׁעָה אַחַת:
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «the early» generations of «pious» men «would wait one hour» in order to achieve the solemn frame of mind appropriate for prayer.

moves.cueHe: חסידים הראשונים היו שוהין שעה אחת
moves.summary: the gemara quotes the mishna's clause about the early pious waiting an hour, opening its discussion
moves.about: the mishna's statement that the early pious would wait one hour before praying, quoted as a lemma
